name: PM-KISAN Samman Nidhi
benefit: Eligible farmers can receive financial support of ₹6000 per year.
eligibility: Eligible landholding farmer families as per the scheme rules.
applyText: Apply through the official PM-KISAN portal

name: Soil Health Card Scheme
benefit: Provides soil testing information and recommendations for suitable fertilizers.
eligibility: Farmers who want to test their agricultural soil.
applyText: Visit the official Soil Health Card portal

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana
benefit: Provides insurance protection against eligible crop losses.
eligibility: Eligible farmers growing notified crops in notified areas.
applyText: Apply through the official crop insurance portal

name: Kisan Credit Card
benefit: Provides farmers access to credit for agricultural and related activities.
eligibility: Eligible farmers and agricultural borrowers as per bank rules.
applyText: Contact an eligible bank or financial institution

name: PM Kisan Maandhan Yojana
benefit: Provides pension benefits to eligible small and marginal farmers after meeting scheme conditions.
eligibility: Eligible small and marginal farmers according to scheme rules.
applyText: Apply through an authorised CSC or official channel
